senses.definition: n.f. sluggishness;—ע׳ Pr 19:15; du. intens. עֲצַלְתַּיִם Ec 10:18 double (i.e. great) sluggishness (so Thes De al.; read then perhaps עַצְלָתַיִם; > from עָצֵל a sluggish pair, i.e. hands Ew al.), but improb.; ‖ שִׁפְלוּת יָדַיִם, whence Bi conj. עַצְלוּת, Siegf עַצְלַת יָדַיִם.
